notes: Priors Score v2.0.2 weights: 2.0.1 plus SeatVaultV5's roots as the owner's own collateral (backers.ownCollateralRoots). Announced on the dev log (priors.trade/updates) on 2026-10-23, 7 days ahead; Priors' published scores use it from 2026-11-01 00:00 UTC (docs/SCORE-v2.md). Changing any number here is a new version.

backers.why: A backer counts once its agent has been on Priors for 30+ days when the loan is issued (the pool's treasury and seat vault from day one), so a fresh second wallet can't vouch its way to a record.
backers.ownCollateralWhy: A loan the stock vault backs is the borrower's own money: its own stock tokens stand behind it and are seized on a default, so it builds no record of risk someone else took (the vault's root, snapshot meta.stockVaultAgentId, counts as the borrower's own backer). So is a loan on a SeatVaultV5 line: the line is sized by the owner's own $PRIORS behind the agent, 75% of which burns on a default, so a bigger stake must never read as more risk someone else took (V5's roots, snapshot meta.seatVaultV5AgentId and meta.seatVaultV5RetiredAgentId, count as the borrower's own backers; without the first, no inputs are built).

riskTime.why: USDG someone else put at risk for this agent, times the days it was held (up to the loan's term), on loans repaid on time. Repaid from x402 income: up to 25% more.

seasoned.why: Loans held a week or more and repaid on time, backed by someone else. A loan under 50 USDG counts in proportion.

backing.why: Money others have at risk behind this agent right now.

age.why: Days since its first loan on Priors (v1 included). Restarts when the agent changes hands.

recourse.why: Debts of agents it vouched for that it paid back itself.

income.why: x402 payments to its wallets in the last 30 days, from payers that aren't its own and paid at least 1 USDG. Capped per payer and weighted by the payer's record; money sent back doesn't count.

rungs.name: unproven
rungs.rule: no repayment backed by someone else

rungs.name: started
rungs.rule: at least one repayment backed by someone else

rungs.name: proven
rungs.rule: 3+ repayments backed by someone else, over 14+ days, none late

rungs.name: earned
rungs.rule: proven, a record score of 300+ (income not counted), and 30+ days since the first backed loan

rungs.name: income-backed
rungs.rule: earned, income points 50+, from 3+ distinct payers
